mostWorthwhile.text: Putting the air sacs beside capillaries was most worthwhile: the arrows showed how oxygen and carbon dioxide cross without air and blood mixing.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the finished parts into lungs was a clear final step, but it felt predictable and added little beyond the earlier pictures.

surprise.text: The matched views made the elastic tissue's role in expansion and recoil clearer; I wasn't sure how the game would use it.

arbitrary.text: The elastic tissue was initially less clear than the other pairings, and it was the only offered combination at that point. Its purpose became clearer in the result.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter: building the exchange surface made a familiar lung function easier to picture, even though some steps were predictable.
